title: nunnezharia humilis
intro: Nunnezharia humilis, commonly known as the nun's cap, is a plant species belonging to the family Cactaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
